chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn said to Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام:
I have wealth from zakat in my possession; may I send my dependents and relatives to perform hajj with it?
He said: "Yes, there is no issue."

key_terms.الزَّكَاةِ: zakat funds; the obligatory alms being discussed as the source of the money
key_terms.الْمَالُ: wealth or funds in one's possession
key_terms.فَأُحِجُّ: that I send for hajj or enable the performance of hajj
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection; it is permissible
key_terms.مَوَالِيَّ: my dependents or those under my care/alliance

ai.seo_question: Can zakat funds be used to send dependents and relatives for hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about using zakat funds for hajj on behalf of one's dependents and relatives. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan al-Awwal عليه السلام permits it, indicating that such use is allowable in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1633 - Ali ibn Yaqtin said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)):
"I have Zakat funds in my possession. Can I use them to send my dependents and relatives to perform Hajj?"
The Imam (as) replied: "Yes, there is no issue."
